critical_code_review_comments: protein_guide.py and grain_guide.py are single-line-per-tier files (~30 lines each). Fine for now, but reformat if any editor auto-wraps them.

frontend/app/proteins.tsx and grains.tsx are near-clones of snacks.tsx (same layout, styles, tier icons). Consider extracting a shared <TieredGuideScreen> component in a future refactor iteration to remove ~90% duplication across the 6 guide screens.
Existing vegetables.tsx uses testID 'veg-section-{TIER}' while proteins/grains use 'protein-section-*' / 'grain-section-*'. Not a bug, just a naming inconsistency worth normalising in a future pass.
